risks.title: Foreign exchange rate fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: 80% of sales in 2025 come from abroad and are denominated in currencies other than the US dollar. The impact on sales and costs is quantified: currency variations increased net sales by 0.6%, gross profit by 0.8%, and overhead expenses by 1.4%.

risks.title: Rising raw material costs
risks.score_rationale: Item 1A clearly identifies sensitivity to key raw material costs such as steel, iron, copper, and aluminum. The company has historically passed through cost increases, but the text warns that future increases could impact earnings, as observed in 2025 with tariff impacts.

risks.title: Impact of acquisitions on financial results
risks.score_rationale: Acquisitions are a key growth strategy explicitly mentioned in the 10-K. Integration and amortization expenses related to acquisitions are high ($72.1M in 2025), directly affecting profitability and reported results volatility.

risks.title: Russia-related volatility
risks.score_rationale: Item 1A explicitly mentions the presentation of 'Core adjusted EBITDA' financial measures excluding Russia due to economic and political volatility. Russian operations resulted in a $19.7M adjustment to Adjusted EBITDA in 2025.

risks.title: Gross margin compression
risks.score_rationale: The text indicates a 100 basis point decline in gross margin in 2025, primarily due to inflation and increased costs from tariffs. While price increases partially offset this, margins remain under pressure, as discussed in cost mix analysis.

risks.title: Impact of tariffs
risks.score_rationale: The 10-K explicitly states that U.S. tariffs had a variety of impacts on 2025 results, including reduced sales levels and higher raw material costs. This impact depends on the future evolution of U.S. trade policy.

ai_positioning.summary: ESAB mentions artificial intelligence as a strategic lever for margin expansion. The company is investing in AI and IT infrastructure through its EBXai system to improve operational efficiency. AI initiatives are linked to business process optimization and cost rationalization.
